title: Concordance profile
description: Schema of the meta-model profile (packages/profile/default.yaml and project overrides).

types_dir.description: Folder of type modules a project profile adds, relative to the profile file: one folder per type, read before the keys of the profile itself. Meaningless in the default profile.

groups.description: Groups of types, by slug; every type belongs to one.

label.description: Display label of the group, per interface language.

common_attributes.description: Attributes every entity carries whatever its type, by name; a type may refine one under its own attributes.

types.description: The types a note can have, by slug: the ones the cascade may yield and a frontmatter may declare.

label.description: Display label of the type, per interface language.

description.description: One sentence saying what an entity of the type is, per interface language; the list of a category shows it under its count.

counted.description: The count of a category of the type as an ICU message with a count argument, per interface language: "{count, plural, one {# screen described} other {# screens described}}".

group.description: Slug of the group the type belongs to.

status.description: active types are rendered; planned types belong to the meta-model but are not rendered by this version, and a project may activate them.

glyph.description: Name of the glyph of the type; the site derives the one-letter mark of the type from its first letter.

graph.description: How the type enters the graph: full takes part in every relation; documents-only entities (documents, meetings) are only ever the source of a documents relation.

attributes.description: Attributes specific to the type, by name, added to common_attributes.

sections.description: H2 sections of a note of this type whose content produces relations, by section key.

display.description: What the page of an entity of this type highlights and how its neighbours are ordered.

relations.description: The relations of the meta-model, by slug: their labels, their direction, their cap and the pairs of types they may join.

label.description: Label read from the source of the relation (accesses), per language.

inverse_label.description: Label read from the target of the relation (is accessed by), per language; an undirected relation has none.

directed.description: Whether the relation has a direction; an undirected link is stored from the smaller identifier to the larger.

status.description: active relations are produced; planned ones belong to the meta-model and wait for a producer.

cap.description: Highest confidence a link of this relation can reach, whatever its methods.

target_kind.description: Whether the target of the relation is an entity or a type (applies_to of a standard).

attributes.description: Attributes a link of this relation may carry, by name.

allowed.description: Pairs of types the relation may join, source then target. any matches every type, same requires both ends of one type, type marks a target that is a type rather than an entity. A project profile adds pairs to the default ones.

confidence.description: Confidence of a link by the method that produced it, from 0 to 1; several methods on one link combine as 1 − Π(1 − cᵢ).

explicit_link.description: A markdown link written in a note.

lock_promoted.description: A link promoted in the lock file; no producer in this version.

contract_import.description: A link read from an imported interface contract (an API exposes an endpoint).

frontmatter_ref.description: A reference declared by a frontmatter attribute.

folder_zone.description: A link deduced from where a note is filed; no producer in this version.

section_mention.description: A mention under a section mapped in the profile.

glossary_occurrence.description: A mention of a title or alias in prose: base, raised by per_occurrence for each further occurrence up to cap, multiplied by homonym_factor for a homonym, raised by type_prefix_bonus after a recognised type prefix.

per_occurrence.description: Added for each further occurrence in the same note.

cap.description: Highest confidence occurrences alone can reach.

homonym_factor.description: Factor applied when the form names several entities.

type_prefix_bonus.description: Added when a type prefix announces the mention.

cooccurrence.description: Two entities mentioned in the same paragraph.

embedding.description: Semantic similarity; no producer in this version.

type_prefixes.description: Words that announce the type of the entity that follows in prose (screen Entity page), by locale then by type slug; a recognised prefix adds type_prefix_bonus and tells which type to expect.

label.description: A label per interface language; English is the source, French optional.

en.description: Label in English, the source language of the interface.

fr.description: Label in French; the English one is used when absent.

attribute.description: An attribute a note may declare in its frontmatter, and what it produces.

type.description: Kind of value: a scalar, a list of strings (string[]), an enum among values, a reference to one or several entities (ref, ref[]) of the target types, or a list of structured items described by schema.

values.description: Allowed values of an enum attribute.

default.description: Value of the attribute when the note does not set it.

target.description: Types the referenced entities may have: a type slug, a list of slugs, any, or same for the type of the note itself.

relation.description: Relation the reference produces, from the note to the referenced entity, at the frontmatter_ref confidence.

inverse.description: Whether the relation goes from the referenced entity to the note instead.

attributes.description: Attributes set on the produced relation (mode: read on an accesses relation).

schema.description: Shape of each item of a list attribute, by field name: string, ref or another attribute type.

label.description: Display label of the attribute, per interface language; the attribute name is shown when absent.

highlight.description: Attributes the site puts forward, in order, five at most: the first filters the list of a category of the type and heads its second column, all of them lead the five keys of the panel of an API; the page of an entity shows them in its panel with the others.

neighbours_order.description: Neighbour types the neighbourhood panel shows first, in priority order; the types not listed come after, by confidence. Each must be a declared type.

display.description: The display rules of a type: the attributes its page highlights and the order of its neighbours.

heading.description: Heading that opens the section, per language; matched without regard to case, accents or whitespace, and the section key itself matches too.

parse.description: Shape of the content of the section: an ordered list, a bullet list, paragraphs or a table.

produces.description: Relation slug each recognised mention of the section produces, at the section_mention confidence.

inverse.description: Whether the relation goes from the mentioned entity to the note instead.

attributes.description: Attributes set on the produced relation.

section.description: An H2 section of a note whose content produces relations.
